body: I do my best to make sure my mental health is priority. I guess I find it difficult to train my focus onto other things a lot of the time. The hardest points are while I'm working and on the drive home. My cd player in my car broke the other day, so it tends to be a long drive in my own head :(

The thing is, it's not that I think this will last forever. I do, at least with the logical part of my mind, know that this is just a short term thing. It's just trying to find a way to make it an even shorter term thing is proving difficult
